title: Steady climb
description: Three upswings in a row take price from 27,260 to 28,608. The second break of structure (28,248 on 16 Oct 17:00) confirms the uptrend, and no downswing follows, so it is still running at the end. Seen live, the pullback overnight looked like the start of a fall: from the prices up to 17 Oct 03:00 a downtrend was confirmed there. The later new high turned that pullback into part of the upleg, which only hindsight shows.
